body:
Do we have anything against inline comments for breaks?
```suggestion
								break; // Less indented -> not part of the current scope -> stop searching.
```

It's not really about scope, braces should be matched in the entire file. Though that would probably have performance concerns.

I also don't like how its indentation based, its very GDScript focused when it should work with any language.
Auto brace completion works inside of strings, so they should also be considered somehow.
